title: Proxy ReadOnly
description:
Implement `readOnly(obj)` that wraps an object in a `Proxy` and throws a `TypeError` on any write attempt. Reads should pass through normally.

**Example:**
```js
const obj = readOnly({ x: 1 });
obj.x;     // 1
obj.x = 2; // throws TypeError
```
ai_context: Common mistake: only trapping set but forgetting deleteProperty. Also forgetting to return true from set when you want normal behavior — but here you always throw, so it's not needed. Students often use Object.freeze instead, which silently ignores writes in non-strict mode.
